question: What is the meaning of the term 'Utsuro-bune' in Japanese?

question: Which monument in Delhi was completed during the reign of Sultan Iltutmish in the 13th century and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site?

question: What controversy involved the Fallout 76 Power Armor edition's physical item?
reply: Bethesda advertised the Fallout 76 Power Armor Edition as including a canvas duffel bag, but customers instead received a cheaper nylon bag. Bethesda changed the bag after materials issues without telling buyers (the website only reflected "nylon" after complaints), offered 500 in‑game atoms as compensation (not enough to buy the in‑game canvas bag, which cost 700 atoms), and was criticized when it emerged influencers had been given canvas bags. Bethesda later said it would produce and ship canvas replacements (announced Dec 3, 2018; bags delivered around June 2019). A related problem: a support‑site glitch exposed personal data of dozens of customers who requested the replacement.

وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ...
